paraphrase: In his general account of India Xuanzang describes non-Buddhist ascetics of many kinds - some wearing peacock feathers, some adorned with necklaces of skulls, some naked, some smearing their bodies with ash; elsewhere he notes ash-smearing ascetics at many sites.
notes: Opponent's / outsider's report: Xuanzang, Buddhist pilgrim. Juan 2; from memory, low confidence on wording.
